name: Amazonas
summary_text: The national framework applies in Amazonas with no state-specific legal deviation documented — no facility or expression statute, ordinance series or enforcement pattern was found, and the 2025 monitoring data place the state in the lowest national band (0-3 killings of trans people), with the dossier's caveat that Brazilian counts are floors and single cases swing small-state rates. Federally administered indigenous territories with parallel community authority cover much of Amazonas; the dossier found no trans-specific evidence for them. The capital, Manaus, concentrates the state's limited public LGBT infrastructure, consistent with the national interior-versus-capital divide.

sources.claim_summary: Wikipedia overview of LGBTQ rights in Brazil: STF-guaranteed gender-identity protections and 2019 phobia-as-racism ruling nationally, with per-state non-binary birth-certificate practice; Amazonas' row records that non-binary people receive name changes on documents while the gender options remain binary and no state law establishes the option.

sources.title: Brazil | Outright International
sources.claim_summary: Outright International Brazil overview (updated 12 March 2026): progressive STF framework beside the world's highest absolute trans-violence toll, repeal pressure in Congress and anti-LGBTIQ proposals — the uniform national backdrop Amazonas shares; no Amazonas-specific content.

Expat legal guide (updated 5 April 2026): STF protections (marriage, adoption, marker changes without surgery, phobia-as-racism) in a country 'progressive on paper and uneven in practice', with real protection concentrated in major cities — the unevenness caveat applies sharply to remote interior states like Amazonas.
